llmConfigName.description: The name of the LLM config to use for document hierarchy parsing.

pageToStopTableOfContentDetection.description: End page up to which the table of content detection should be done.

earlyStopTableOfContentDetectionIncremen.description: The minimum number of pages to be considered for table of content detection.

targetTableOfContentStrings.description: If the header text contains these values, then only do table of content detection.

tableOfContentDetectionMode.description:
Different modes to detect table of content. (conditional, full_sweep, disable)
conditional: Detect table of content only if the header text contains the #targetTableOfContentStrings.
full_sweep: Detect table of content for all pages.
disable: Disable table of content detection.

fuzzyMatchThreshold.description: Threshold for fuzzy matching of header text with targetTableOfContentStrings.

prefixesToRemove.description: The list of prefixes to be removed before fuzzy matching.

tableOfContentDetectionPrompt.description: The prompt to be used for table of content detection.

title: Defines the spec for the Document Hierarchy used in {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.MultimodalPdf}.
